howto.name: Upload a JPG image
howto.text: Drag or select one or more .jpg / .jpeg files.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. PrivaTools re-encodes the JPEG as a lossless PNG, preserving every pixel and supporting transparency in re-edits.

faq.a: PNG is lossless — every pixel of the source is preserved. Use PNG when you plan to do further editing (each JPG save degrades the image) or when you need transparency in compositing.
Yes — typically 3–10× larger, because PNG is lossless while JPG is compressed. For photos, JPG is usually a better choice unless you specifically need lossless quality.
Standard EXIF data is preserved when possible. Color profiles (sRGB, Adobe RGB) are written into the PNG header.
